title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E08 — Familiar Foes
The remaining competitors face the most extreme trick shots of seasons past; contestants open capped bottles, blow cotton swabs to bits and knock soda cans out of the air; two players must successfully man Hotchkiss Cannons.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E09 — Big Boom
Competitors blast clay birds mid-flight with Benelli shotguns; the crossbow pits two competitors against each other.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E10 — Zip or Ship
The marksmen are strapped to a mechanical arm and sent soaring with the SP89; two competitors zoom down a zip line course.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E11 — A Game of Horse
The marksmen fire the Browning M1919 from a rolling Army half-track; competitors call the shots in a game of horse.

title: Top Shot All-Stars
description:
S05 E12 — Last Man Standing
The final four must crawl through a tunnel, dodge barbed wire and slither through mud with an AK-47.

S01 E01 — Pilot
Emergency response providers put their lives at risk to save others.

title: 15 Septembers Later
description: President George W. Bush, Vice President Dick Cheney, Mayor Rudolph Giuliani, and others provide a new perspective on the 9/11 terrorist attacks; the day's events are seen anew through the lens of declassified documents, photographs and information.

title: 102 Minutes That Changed America: 15th Anniversary
description: A first-person video and audio account of Sept. 11, 2001, featuring footage from numerous sources and in-the-moment commentary to provide a minute-by-minute record of that fateful day.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E01 — Loyal Subject
Sent by the British to deliver an ultimatum, the inexperienced young officer learns a hard lesson about leadership when his failures in the field inadvertently kick off a world war.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E02 — Rebel Commander
As the American colonies make their final break, their newly minted commander-in-chief realizes he's been handed a nearly impossible task in fighting the most powerful armed force in the world with an undisciplined ragtag group of soldiers.

title: Washington
description:
S01 E03 — Father of His Country
The Revolution has been won, but as warring nations attack America's borders and uprisings threaten from within, Washington builds the new United States up with his bare hands while enduring treachery and personal attacks.

title: Biography
description:
George Washington: Founding Father
George Washington's wealth and popularity make him a natural choice for president.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S02 E01 — The Ancient Astronaut Cover-Up
Exploring the idea that aliens have been visiting Earth for centuries.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S02 E07 — Presidential Cover-Ups
Uncover the stories behind the greatest White House scandals; from Iran-Contra to Benghazi, discover how much secrecy exists in an office designed to operate with transparency.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S03 E04 — The Gold Conspiracy
The world surrounding gold, the highly prized metal, and why people go will go to great lengths to obtain it.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S03 E09 — The Secret Service
An inside look at the Secret Service, a top-secret law enforcement agency made up of men and women who put their lives on the line to protect current and former U.S. leaders and their families; a special agent reveals the grueling selection process.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S03 E08 — Secret Underground
Exploring underground facilities in the United States, which could hold dangerous secrets.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S02 E12 — Hell's Angels
The Hells Angels Motorcycle Club evolves from a small group of bikers into an organized crime syndicate.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E01 — The Secret Space Program
On Dec. 20, 2019, Space Force is established, but in 2002, a man named Gary McKinnon claimed he had discovered evidence that a secret military space program already existed after hacking top-secret Pentagon and NASA computers.
